manifest.scope: closed-loop mission command test with synthetic UWB and virtual horizontal obstacles

patched_firmware.simulation_truth_stream: ODOMETRY estimator_type=NAIVE, LOCAL_NED, sample timestamp, float coordinates

manifest.lidar_observation: 10 Hz sequential noisy rays -> aligned capture-time IMU deskew -> spatial/temporal robust matcher -> interval midpoint NE velocity
manifest.random_seed_scope: seed applies to synthetic UWB; seed+10000 independently to synthetic LiDAR. SIH sensor RNG is not overridden.
manifest.obstacle_transform: Synthetic ranges use truth; placement uses same-time FC estimated XY. No truth position is supplied to the guard.

run8_core_alignment.note: Not a full run8 reproduction. Synthetic sensor mounting is zero.

manifest.time_contract: EV phase-decimated to <=40 Hz with HIL capture timestamp; flow trapezoidal integrals with capture timestamp

predeclared.note: braking criteria apply after the mission reaches MOVING; no 3D collision guarantee

criterion.scope: fixed target; no mean subtraction; both FC and simulator truth
fixed target; no mean subtraction; both FC and simulator truth

first_10s_ulog.scope: High-rate native FC/physics samples in the preselected mission window

frontend.scope: offline SIH interval displacement; no ground truth is passed to scan matcher
frontend.covariance_scope: explicit simulation model; not physical calibration

scope: isolated simulation; capture-time gyro/clock alignment; no physical calibration
